label: Chhena poda
note: Chhena kneaded with sugar and semolina and baked, not cooked in syrup; the flavour is caramelised sugar

about.text: Chhena poda, Odia for burnt cheese, is a baked sweet of Odisha made from kneaded chhena, sugar and semolina, browned for several hours so that the sugar caramelises. It is credited to Sudarsan Sahu of Dashapalla after 1947.
